concept.title: Use cases for the Node Maintenance Operator
concept.shortdesc: The Node Maintenance Operator is a "Rolling Stream" Operator, meaning updates are available asynchronously of OpenShift Container Platform releases.

conbody.p: The Node Maintenance Operator watches for new or deleted NodeMaintenance CRs. When a new NodeMaintenance CR is detected, no new workloads are scheduled and the node is cordoned off from the rest of the cluster. All pods that can be evicted are removed from the node. When a NodeMaintenance CR is deleted, the node that is referenced in the CR is made available for new workloads.

note.p: Using a NodeMaintenance CR for node maintenance tasks achieves the same results as the oc adm cordon and oc adm drain commands using standard Red Hat OpenShift CR processing.
